name: State of Digital Signage Pricing 2026
note: Published list prices only; n/v = not verified by us; monthly billing unless stated; hardware, taxes and negotiated discounts excluded.

vendors.unit: per screen per month (dynamic volume pricing)
vendors.platforms: Windows, Mac, Android, Chrome OS, Raspberry Pi, iPad, browser
vendors.note: Enterprise adds proof of play, white-label, kiosk/touch, IoT, POS; priced by the public calculator

vendors.free: 1 screen, forever, Basic features, only while the account has exactly 1 screen; new accounts since Mar 2, 2026 first get a 30-day full-access period on up to 5 screens, then continue on the 1-screen Free plan
vendors.note: Prices raised Apr 1, 2026. Verified 2026-09-28: pricing page lists Free $0 single-screen licence; Yodeck docs (30-day free period, updated 2026-09-21) confirm the account continues on the Free Plan with basic features after the 30-day period. Sources: https://www.yodeck.com/pricing/ ; https://www.yodeck.com/docs/user-manual/free-period/

vendors.free: 3 screens, with OptiSigns branding (logo on screen); free plan limited to OptiSigns, Windows, Linux and Raspberry Pi players
vendors.top: $45 Enterprise (minimum 25 screens; $40.50 billed annually); Engage $30, Pro Plus $15, Pro $12.50
vendors.unit: per screen per month (about 10% less billed annually: Standard $9)
vendors.note: 1GB storage and 25 basic apps on the free plan. Re-read 2026-10-04: the top published tier is Enterprise ($45, minimum 25 screens); earlier versions carried Engage ($30) as the top tier.

vendors.top: Enterprise: quote, annual only (Pro $30 billed annually, $36 monthly)

vendors.entryName: Basic (K-12, higher ed, non-profit; business and government $12)
vendors.top: K-12 Enterprise $164 per display per year, or $1,399 per school per year with unlimited displays (Advanced $138 per display per year)

vendors.entryName: Renewal: $20 per player per year; first year $35 per new player
